driverRef.description: Opaque reference, never a name or licence number.

unitNumber.description: Free-form for a domestic road trailer. For a CONTAINER, or when `unitNumberScheme` is ISO6346, an ISO 6346 container number such as CSQU3054383 (422 `invalid-unit-number` otherwise).

unitNumberScheme.description: Optional. Declares that the unit number is an ISO 6346 number and must pass its check digit. A CONTAINER is always checked.

sealNumber.description: The seal found at the gate; compared with the appointment's expected seal.

sealClass.description: Optional ISO 17712 class of the seal (I indicative, S security, H high security); needs a sealNumber. Refused with 409 `seal-class-too-low` when below the `minimumSealClass` of the site yard policy.

hazmatClass.description: Optional. The US DOT hazard class or division of what the trailer carries (49 CFR 172.101). Any other value is 422 `invalid-hazmat-class`. A trailer that declares one is placed only on a HAZMAT spot (ADR 0014).

unNumber.description: Optional. The UN number of the material, `UN` and four digits; needs a `hazmatClass` (422 `validation`), malformed is 422 `invalid-un-number`.

requiresTemperatureControl.description: Optional. True for a load that needs a refrigeration plug; such a trailer is placed only on a REEFER_PLUG spot where the site has any (ADR 0014).

trailers.description: Trailers brought in. BOBTAIL and PICKUP bring none; a visit that names an appointment brings exactly one.
